## Re-Guard customer e-mails
Every webhook (13 legacy paths + `reguard-notify`) feeds **Render Email**, which dispatches on `event` (CONTRACT §6) and renders one shared, branded template; **Send Email** sends it via Gmail.

Webhooks require header `X-Reguard-Token` (credential **Re-Guard Webhook Token**).
Unknown event / invalid recipient → the execution fails (backend sees HTTP 500).

Edit templates in `n8n/src/render-email.js`, then `node n8n/build-workflow.mjs` and re-import. See `n8n/README.md`.
